name: Glass Violet
tagline: favstash's adaptive-glass: the speaker with moving proof in frosted violet glass panels, soft-violet palette.

motion.direction: favstash `adaptive-glass`, soft-violet. The speaker plus "moving proof" in frosted glass panels (`card` / `pip` modes = half and third splits, hard seam), palette taken from the room: violet `stage`, glow `mar`, deep `goldd`, heading ink `ink`, text `iv`. Panels arrive by moving ~18 px over 0.42 s ease-out (never fade an ancestor), shared-shape transitions 0.45–0.8 s, at most one low sweep after settling. Headings 52–76 px, captions ~54 px 1–2 lines on a dark backing when over footage; artefacts "enter on the noun, act on the verb". Camera shutter 4 frames before a layout cut; frame 1 already shows proof moving.
